recommendation: Recommend Option A: accept the semantic stop as correct, terminate this lineage without filtering, repair or waiver, preserve all artifacts, and prepare a separately identified prospective successor. Bind all 609 passive URLs into its cumulative exposure denylist before freezing it; do not use any result from this failed execution as unseen candidate evidence.
rationale: The executed search mechanics complied with the authorization, but non-overlap is an eligibility invariant rather than a correctable output field. Removing ten overlaps after seeing the results would be retrospective filtering, while promoting the other 599 would ignore that the complete bundle failed and all results are now exposed. A distinct prospective successor preserves methodological integrity while retaining a bounded route forward.

The bundle's incomplete-predecessor acknowledgement prevents any global claim of non-overlap even apart from the ten reconstructed overlaps.
abstentions: No result URL, landing page, file or source content was requested or opened during this review.
